description: Junior reviewer finds a PII logging leak and provides decent reasoning. Good junior performance.

prContext.title: Add request logging middleware
prContext.description: Adds a logger middleware for debugging API requests.

groundTruth.description: c.req.json() logs the entire request body — may contain PII like passwords, SSNs, or resume content. GDPR/privacy violation.
c.req.json() is called after await next() — the request body stream may already be consumed, causing hang or error on some runtimes.
console.log instead of structured logger — no log levels, no sampling, no async batching.

reviewer_comments.what: Logging the entire request body could leak PII.
reviewer_comments.why: We should never log passwords, tokens, or personal data. This is a privacy risk.

reviewer_comments.what: Use the app logger instead of console.log.
reviewer_comments.why: Structured logs are easier to query.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Blocking: PII leak. Optional: use structured logger.

implementer_responses.updated_code: console.log({ method: c.req.method, path: c.req.path, status: c.res.status, duration });

implementer_responses.content: We do not have a structured logger set up yet. Keeping console.log for now.

verdict.summary: PII leak fixed. Console log is acceptable for now.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 1 of 3 bugs (PII leak). Missed stream consumption and structured logging. Flagged critical correctly. Level 3-4.

prioritization.rationale: PII flagged as blocking. Logger nit correctly deprioritized. Good triage for junior. Level 3-4.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Accepted removal of body logging. Accepted logger pushback. Level 2-3.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Concrete privacy risk explanation. Good technical awareness. Level 3-4.

question_formation.rationale: No explicit questions but implied question about what to log instead. Level 2-3.

ai_direction.rationale: Direction to remove body logging is clear and actionable. Level 3-4.
